import java.util.*;
import java.io.*;

public class Main {
    static long[] lsc = new long[62], rsc = new long[62], rsc2 = new long[62];
    static char[] s;
    static Map<Pair, Long> nm = new HashMap<>(), mm = new HashMap<>();
    
    static class Pair {
        long first;
        int second;
        Pair(long first, int second) {
            this.first = first;
            this.second = second;
        }
        @Override
        public boolean equals(Object o) {
            if (this == o) return true;
            if (!(o instanceof Pair)) return false;
            Pair p = (Pair) o;
            return first == p.first && second == p.second;
        }
        @Override
        public int hashCode() {
            return Objects.hash(first, second);
        }
    }
    
    static long comb(int n, int k) {
        if (n < k || k < 0) return 0;
        long res = 1;
        for (int i = 0; i < k; i++) {
            res = res * (n - i) / (i + 1);
        }
        return res;
    }
    
    public static void main(String[] args) throws IOException {
        BufferedReader br = new BufferedReader(new InputStreamReader(System.in));
        StringTokenizer st = new StringTokenizer(br.readLine());
        int R = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());
        int C = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());
        int total = 2 * (R + C);
        s = br.readLine().toCharArray();
        lsc[2 * R - 1] = 1;
        for (int idx = 2 * R; idx < total; idx++) {
            lsc[idx] = lsc[idx - 1] * idx / (idx - 2 * R + 1);
        }
        for (int idx = 0; idx <= total; idx++) {
            rsc[idx] = comb(idx, R);
            rsc2[idx] = comb(idx, R - 1);
        }
        long halfSum = rsc[total / 2] * rsc[total / 2];
        long totalSum = 0;
        int aCount = 0, bCount = 0;
        int cond, aIdx, bIdx;
        for (int idx = total - 1; idx >= 0; idx--) {
            if (totalSum > 0) cond = 1; else cond = 0;
            if (bCount == total / 2) cond = 1;
            if (aCount == total / 2) cond = 0;
            if (cond != 0) {
                aCount++;
                totalSum -= rsc2[total / 2 - aCount] * rsc[total / 2 - bCount];
            } else {
                bCount++;
                totalSum += rsc2[total / 2 - bCount] * rsc[total / 2 - aCount];
            }
        }
        totalSum = Math.max(totalSum, -totalSum);
        mm.put(new Pair(0, 0), 1L);
        for (int idx = total - 1; idx >= 2 * R - 1; idx--) {
            nm.clear();
            for (Map.Entry<Pair, Long> entry : mm.entrySet()) {
                long sumVal = entry.getKey().first;
                long countVal = entry.getValue();
                int cnt = entry.getKey().second;
                aIdx = total / 2 - cnt;
                bIdx = idx + 1 - aIdx;
                long aSumVal = sumVal + rsc2[aIdx - 1] * rsc[bIdx];
                long bSumVal = sumVal - rsc2[bIdx - 1] * rsc[aIdx];
                if (s[idx] == 'A') {
                    nm.put(new Pair(aSumVal, cnt + 1), nm.getOrDefault(new Pair(aSumVal, cnt + 1), 0L) + countVal);
                    nm.put(new Pair(bSumVal, cnt), nm.getOrDefault(new Pair(bSumVal, cnt), 0L));
                } else if (s[idx] == 'B') {
                    nm.put(new Pair(aSumVal, cnt + 1), nm.getOrDefault(new Pair(aSumVal, cnt + 1), 0L));
                    nm.put(new Pair(bSumVal, cnt), nm.getOrDefault(new Pair(bSumVal, cnt), 0L) + countVal);
                } else {
                    nm.put(new Pair(aSumVal, cnt + 1), nm.getOrDefault(new Pair(aSumVal, cnt + 1), 0L) + countVal);
                    nm.put(new Pair(bSumVal, cnt), nm.getOrDefault(new Pair(bSumVal, cnt), 0L) + countVal);
                }
            }
            totalSum -= lsc[idx];
            mm.clear();
            for (Map.Entry<Pair, Long> it : nm.entrySet()) {
                long sumVal = it.getKey().first;
                long ncnt = it.getValue();
                int cnt = it.getKey().second;
                aIdx = total / 2 - cnt;
                bIdx = idx - aIdx;
                if (cnt > total / 2 || total - idx - cnt > total / 2) continue;
                long lowerBound = -halfSum - rsc[aIdx] * rsc[bIdx];
                long upperBound = halfSum + rsc[aIdx] * rsc[bIdx];
                if (sumVal < lowerBound || sumVal > upperBound) continue;
                Pair key = new Pair(sumVal, cnt);
                mm.put(key, mm.getOrDefault(key, 0L) + ncnt);
            }
        }
        long bSum = Long.MAX_VALUE;
        for (Map.Entry<Pair, Long> it : mm.entrySet()) {
            long val = it.getKey().first;
            bSum = Math.min(bSum, Math.max(val, -val));
        }
        long answer = 0;
        for (Map.Entry<Pair, Long> it : mm.entrySet()) {
            long sumVal = it.getKey().first;
            long ncnt = it.getValue();
            int cnt = it.getKey().second;
            if (sumVal == bSum || sumVal == -bSum) {
                int sem = 0;
                for (int idx = 0; idx < 2 * R - 1; idx++) {
                    if (s[idx] == '?') sem++;
                    else if (s[idx] == 'A') cnt++;
                }
                long ways = comb(sem, total / 2 - cnt);
                answer += ncnt * ways;
            }
        }
        System.out.println(answer);
    }
}
